notes: 📰 New: AI News in the Glow apps menu. The day's AI stories in one place, refreshed twice a day (07:00 and 19:00 WIB)
The same story from different outlets is shown once with all its sources, ranked by how widely it's covered, community votes and freshness
A 5-point briefing, a 'why it matters' line on top stories, topics (Models, Research, Tools, Business, Policy & safety, Open source) and search
✨ 'New for you' shows only what came in since your last visit; 🔖 save stories to read later, even after they leave the edition
💬 Ask Glow on any story (or the whole briefing) opens GlowChat with the story and its sources ready to discuss
Glow home shows today's top 3 AI stories, and the last edition you saw still opens offline

Simpler settings: your own AI keys and services (OpenRouter, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama and other APIs) are hidden for now in GlowChat and GlowRoom. The built-in free AI covers it, no keys or setup needed
🆓 More free AI with no sign-in, built in like Puter: Llama 3.3 70B, GPT-OSS 120B, Qwen 3.5 397B and Mistral Small 3.2 (OVHcloud) plus LLM7 sit next to Glow Free. No key, no account
